sloka: कदाचित् शिखरे तस्य पर्वतस्य अपि तिष्ठते ।कबंधः तु अनुशास्य एवम् तौ उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-७३-४२॥
transliteration: kadācit śikhare tasya parvatasya api tiṣṭhate ।kabaṁdhaḥ tu anuśāsya evam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-73-42॥

translations.english: Having instructed both Rama and Lakshmana, courageous Kabandha, wearing a flowergarland, shone brightly like the Sun in the sky.
